data.one_liner: Auxiliary classes for reliably running periodic tasks in long-running processes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a framework to run periodic maintenance tasks on a loop with a long delay in background processes like a web server. It handles limits on run-times, retries failed executions, catches exceptions, and can optionally prevent concurrent tasks using storage services.
use_when: You need to run background maintenance operations inside a long-running Dart process like a web server
You want to limit task run-time, retry failed executions, and log periodic task statuses reliably
avoid_when: You are running client-side Flutter UI applications without long-running background server processes
You need complex out-of-band cloud scheduling managed entirely outside of your application codebase
strengths: Retries failed task executions automatically after a timeout
Limits maximum run-time to prevent hanging loops
Catches and logs all exceptions and errors from tasks
weaknesses: Relies on the application process staying alive continuously
Lacks built-in cloud cron UI configuration out of the box
